intro.h2: From small fixes to full rebuilds, done by Cole
paragraphs: RC Handy is Cole Stewart's handyman and home remodeling business in Denver, CO, and his clients tend to keep him. One family has used Cole for years, for everything from deck construction to custom wrought iron railings to refinishing their hardwood floors. Another homeowner had her mountain home damaged by a smoke fire, had to gut it and start over, and says Cole worked tirelessly until it was finished, correctly.

Cole starts with a plan. He asks what you want, shows you what is available, and catches the things that would not have worked before they happen. He answers the phone, returns texts and emails, and cleans up after himself.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Our before and after photos show a bathroom taken down to bare concrete and rebuilt with a freestanding soaking tub and floor-mounted filler, a walnut-tone vanity with a vessel sink, a one-piece toilet and wood-look tile floor. Call to talk through the bathroom you have in mind.

image.alt: Before and after of a gutted basement bathroom rebuilt with a freestanding tub, wood vanity with vessel sink and wood-look tile floor

items.name: Gut renovations and rebuilds
items.blurb: When a smoke fire damaged a client's mountain home, it had to be gutted. Cole rebuilt it with bright painted walls and beams, new plank flooring throughout and a fresh kitchen wall. The owner, who inspects construction sites for a living, says he worked tirelessly until it was done.

image.alt: Rebuilt cabin interior with white painted beams and stairs, new wood-look plank flooring and an open living area

items.name: Kitchen updates
items.blurb: In that same rebuilt cabin, the kitchen run got new gray base cabinets, a fresh countertop, a stainless range and wood-look plank floors that carry through to the living room. Cole walks you through what is available and what your options are, so the choices are yours.

image.alt: Cabin kitchen with new gray base cabinets, a stainless range, a wood island cart and plank flooring under a sloped ceiling

items.name: Custom railings and woodworking
items.blurb: Cole builds custom railings to suit the room. Here, square black metal balusters with a natural oak cap rail and oak stair treads open up a split-level kitchen and family room. A longtime client calls Cole an absolute master when it comes to building and woodworking.

image.alt: Half wall railing with a natural oak cap rail and square black metal balusters above oak stairs, white kitchen behind

items.name: Floors, decks, doors and lighting
items.blurb: Cole refinishes hardwood floors and builds decks, and he takes on the smaller jobs too. One client had him put wire mesh around their deck, put up lights and refinish several interior doors, and calls him reasonably priced and punctual, their go-to handyman for a long time.

about.h2: About Cole Stewart and RC Handy
about.text: RC Handy is run by Cole Stewart, whom one client introduced as Mr. RC Handy. Clients describe him as smart, capable, honest and hard working, with good manners and good timing. He takes small jobs like lights and door refinishing, and big ones like rebuilding a smoke-damaged mountain home after it was gutted. One family has kept him on call for years, for decks, railings, floors and woodworking. A homeowner who has inspected construction for 25 years says hiring him is a decision you will not regret.

items.name: Kim G.
items.text:
Look no further. This is a safe place. The place you’ve been looking for. Someone you can trust to show up, price it right and get it done on time. Someone that answers the phone and returns texts and emails.

Meet Cole Stewart, Mr. RC Handy. The answer to your problems.

Cole starts with a plan. He’ll want to know what your plans are. Then he shows you what’s available, what your options are. And you know those things that ALWAYS crop up? Those “gosh, I thought that would work better” things? Cole sees them before they happen. He also won’t chew your face off if you change your mind a little. ( you might get an eye roll😊)

I’ve known Cole to be a hard working, honest man. I loved working with him. He saved our dreams after a smoke fire damaged our mountain home. We had to gut it and start over. Cole was there for us. He worked tirelessly until it was finished. Correctly. And did I mention that he cleans up after himself?

Folks, this is no snow job. I’ve worked doing draw release inspections on construction sites for 25 years. I know what I’m talking about here. Cole is the real thing.
Hire him. You won’t regret it.

Kim Giarratano
Owner, Construction Progress Inspectors

Cole is one of the smartest and most capable handymen I've worked with.  We've been using Cole's services for years now, and he seems to be the best at everything from deck construction, to building custom wrought iron railings, to refinishing our hardwood floors.
Cole is an absolute master when it comes to building and woodworking and his prices are well worth the end result.  If you are looking for an honest, hard working guy then I can't recommend him enough.

service_area.h2: Handyman and home remodeling in Denver, CO
service_area.text: RC Handy serves Denver, CO, and Cole works in clients' homes, from a split-level family home to a mountain cabin rebuilt after smoke damage. If you live outside Denver and want to know whether you are in range, call (303) 570-8839 Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 7 PM or Friday until 6 PM, or email revolvercustom@gmail.com with your town and a short description of the job.

items.q: What kinds of jobs does RC Handy take?
items.a: Bathroom remodels, gut renovations, kitchen updates, custom metal and wood railings, hardwood floor refinishing, decks and woodworking, plus smaller jobs like refinishing doors, hanging lights or adding wire mesh around a deck. If you are not sure your job fits, call Cole and describe it.

items.q: Can you rebuild after fire or smoke damage?
items.a: Yes. A client's mountain home was damaged by a smoke fire and had to be gutted. Cole rebuilt it and, in her words, worked tirelessly until it was finished, correctly. Our before and after photos show the cabin with new floors, painted beams and a fresh kitchen wall.

Yes. One client has used Cole for years and names building custom wrought iron railings among his strengths. Our photos show square black metal balusters with natural oak cap rails and oak stair treads in a split-level home, alongside refinished hardwood floors.

RC Handy is open Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 7 PM and Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (303) 570-8839 during those hours, or email revolvercustom@gmail.com any time and Cole will get back to you.

items.q: How much will my project cost?
items.a: Every job is priced on its own, so call or email with what you want done. Clients describe Cole's pricing as right and reasonable, and one longtime client says his prices are well worth the end result. Cole will go over your options before work starts.

final_cta.h2: Got a project that needs a plan?
final_cta.text: Call Cole Monday through Friday and tell him what you have in mind.
